item.title: Sensor not working, 5th August
item.description:
The traffic light sensor on elmstead lane heading towards William barefoot drive does not pick up waiting traffic, so you're constantly sitting waiting for a vehicle to come from William barefoot drive into elmstead lane. So the traffic lights will change and give a phase, so the sensor that senses traffic does not work. And it's giving too much time to mottingham road when there's no vehicles, there' causing a backlog during the evening/ night been like it weeks now

item.title: Street light glare into house, 4th August
item.description:
For years, the street light outside 24 Mossbury Road had a horrible glare inside our house. The council years ago tried to put a shield which actually does nothing for the glare. Now, we have a newborn baby and this is disturbing his sleep as the glare comes into the first floor and ground floor of our house. Please can this be addressed and sorted. The shield needs to cover the area where the light is and be wide and deep enough to block the light coming into our home.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 22,24,26,28, Mossbury Road, Clapham Junction, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
